verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a full public API (HTTP capture, OpenAPI spec confirmed live at /openapi.json), a dedicated CLI for terminal/CI/agent use, and an official MCP server enabling AI agents/editors to run queries, ship flags, and triage issues via plain text—clearly satisfying agentic, documented programmatic access. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports specifically validating the API/MCP workflows beyond vendor docs.
